name: transportation_tier1_tripgen
description: Calculate trip generation based on ITE methodology. Takes proposed land uses and sizes, applies standard trip generation rates, and outputs trip counts for daily and peak periods.

land_uses.description: Array of land use objects with ite_code, name, size, and size_unit. Example: [{"ite_code": "220", "name": "Residential", "size": 100, "size_unit": "dwelling_units"}]

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction for any local rate adjustments (NYC or generic)

am_peak_trips.description: AM peak hour vehicle trip ends

pm_peak_trips.description: PM peak hour vehicle trip ends

trip_breakdown.description: Detailed breakdown of trips by land use category

summary_report.description: Formatted summary report of trip generation analysis

visualization.description: HTML table visualization of trip generation results
